Active project

Revup Motors LLC

We engineered a high-performance booking and management suite designed to synchronize every moving part of a modern auto shop. By integrating live inventory data with physical bay availability, we eliminated the guesswork from automotive scheduling.

  • Real-Time Logistics: Our engine syncs mechanic availability with live parts stock to ensure every appointment is actionable.
  • The Bunshin Lightbulb: We utilize VIN-based tracking to maintain a permanent service "DNA" for every vehicle, ensuring history remains intact across multiple owners.
  • Secure Customer Portal: We built a dedicated hub for clients to manage their vehicle lifecycle, download invoices, and digitally approve quotes in seconds.
  • Live Supplier Integrations: Our team integrated direct APIs with NAPA and AutoZone for real-time pricing and stock validation.
  • Smart Automation: We deployed Twilio-powered SMS and automated email triggers that calculate service needs based on database mileage records.
